meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: сделать всё возможное = do everything possible
after a plural noun or pronoun: вы все
at the start of a sentence
followed by genitive plural in nominative/accusative
plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: в деревню = to the village; в деревне = in the country

examples.trans: Run to the village to your mum's.
In summer we live in the country.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: My wife took over all my income.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

забрать.gloss: to take back, to take away

meanings.en: to take away, to pick up

meanings.note: забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement

examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.
He will be able to protect me.
I was born and grew up here.

испугаться.gloss: to get scared, to be frightened

meanings.en: to get scared, to take fright

examples.trans: What is it, little guy, are you scared?
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
declines like какой: какая-то, какое-то, какие-то
снимать деньги с карточки = withdraw money from a card

examples.trans: I withdraw money from my card.

meanings.note: мелкими буквами = in small print / small letters

examples.trans: You don't read the small print.
There is only small change in my pocket.

meanings.note: уже месяц = for a month now

examples.trans: I've been living here for a month.
The election is in a month.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun
